title: fix(mcp): preserve actionable gateway cooldown details in 429 errors
author: ale-rls

gist.summary: MCP HTTP 429 errors now pass through the gateway’s message, including the retry duration, instead of replacing it with generic rate-limit advice. Empty response bodies still receive the existing fallback advice. A regression test checks that a publishable-key cooldown message reaches the caller intact.
